item.automata_valkyries.boss_drop_ftl_ac: "Be faster than light." The acceleration loop that spun inside Luxion's legs.
Even stopped, the light still runs along its ∞.
item.automata_valkyries.boss_drop_luxion: The crystal crown that gave birth to a blade at the speed of light.
Its sudden flare is the same color as the last light its victims ever saw.
item.automata_valkyries.boss_drop_gallia: A piece of Galliafort's hull. The afterglow of pruned stars sinks deep within the armor.
One fragment of the shield that turned every blow into a single point.
item.automata_valkyries.boss_drop_distor: The heart of the distortion barrier. When the three lights fully merge, the space inside goes white.
The machine built to let nothing through was the quietest of all.
item.automata_valkyries.boss_drop_necro_: The micro-machine swarm that nested in Memento Mori's wings.
They multiply, fill, crumble and sprout again. What whittles life away knows how to count its own.
item.automata_valkyries.boss_drop_mement: A wing of the death butterfly that danced through the barrage. Even in your palm, it sometimes tries to fly.
The more beautiful a thing, the better it kills.
item.automata_valkyries.boss_drop_time_n: The needle the Time Ruler used each time it pruned a civilization.
On its backward-turning dial, erased hours rise and fade.
item.automata_valkyries.boss_drop_ruler_: The heart of the machine that stopped the world's time. In frozen time, only this kept beating.
For every meshing gear, there is a world it brought to an end.
item.automata_valkyries.boss_drop_memory: The final record of the fallen Luminal Stella civilization.
Its overlapping afterimages are the traces of someone trying, again and again, to remember.
item.automata_valkyries.boss_drop_purifi: The core of Unit Zero, cleansed of its malice. The light leaking from its twelve faces curses no one now.
Endless power, this time to protect.
item.automata_valkyries.boss_drop_singul: The embers of the singularity self-destruct that shattered dimensions in the Fall Catastrophe.
Stare at it long enough, and it is the world that starts to glitch.
